source_row.stem: A nurse teaches a client that lurasidone should be taken with food, and the client assumes this instruction is probably just a general suggestion with little real bearing on how well the medication actually works. The client should instead understand that lurasidone should be taken:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"On a largely empty stomach, since this is thought by some to provide the best absorption of the medication, contrary to the actual food-based instruction this medication requires","B":"Mainly at bedtime, with little consideration given to whether food is taken alongside it, contrary to the food-related instruction that actually matters most for this medication","C":"With food, at least 350 calories, since this significantly increases absorption, rather than being just a general suggestion with little real bearing as the client is currently assuming","D":"With little meaningful relationship between food intake and how well the medication is absorbed, similar to what the client is currently assuming about this instruction"}}
source_row.rationale: Lurasidone should be taken with food (at least 350 calories) since food significantly increases its absorption compared to taking it on an empty stomach.
